chapters.reason: The paper proposes dynamically switching between fast (System 1) and slow (System 2) reasoning modes based on task complexity, fitting the System Switch category.
The work involves adaptive test-time computation and scalable reasoning strategies, aligning with Efficient Test-time Scaling and Infinity Thinking concepts.
The paper evaluates reasoning efficiency on multiple benchmarks, tying into Evaluation and Benchmark for measuring efficiency and trade-offs.
